title: Author Website Checklist

lessons.title: Course Material: Author-Website-Checklist.pdf
lessons.content:
PAGE_1:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 1  Author Website Checklist  Use the checklist below to make sure you’ve completed all of the elements you’ll need for your author website. Create a high-converting sales funnel for your book, an author website to give your readers more information about you, and the incentive and opportunity to buy your book. Element Complete ✓ Traffic generation methods to get people to your site  Advertising  Content Marketing  Social Media  Search Engine Optimization  Opt-In Page  Opt-In Form (from autoresponder)  Lead magnet  Separate Opt-In page  Download page  Call to Action  Follow-Up Emails

PAGE_2:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 2  Sales Page  Sales page copy  Visual elements  Links to buy  Testimonials/Reviews  Blog  Include keywords in content  Enable comments  Respond to interaction  Links to buy  Opt-In form or relevant content upgrade  Social media interaction buttons  Book Description Page  Description copy  Links to buy  Reviews and comments  Excerpt  Social media interaction buttons

PAGE_3:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 3  Testimonials Page  Reviews  Testimonials  Invitation to leave testimonials  Links to buy  Biography  Photo of yourself  Positive reviews and endorsements  Qualifications or experience  Personal details  Your background  Links to buy  Social media interaction buttons

PAGE_4:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 4  Copy Templates  Lead Magnet  Identify what you’ll use as a lead magnet. Examples include:  • Sections of your book • A case study from your book • Data from your book • Templates • Cheat sheets • Blueprints • How-to Reports    Opt-In Page Copy  Include things like:  Ø Learn how to ______ Ø Find out the X steps for ______ Ø Sign up to get your free copy of ____ Ø Learn how to ____ Ø Download the _____ to learn how to _____

PAGE_5:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 5  Sales Page Copy  Include things like:  Ø The problems your readers are facing Ø How you’ll address those problems Ø Why you’re qualified to write this book Ø How your experiences are relevant to them Ø The benefits of reading your book

PAGE_6:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 6  Book Description Page Copy  Include things like:  Ø What you’ll cover in the book Ø How reading this book will benefit your reader Ø What the reader can expect to take away from the book Ø Book reviews/testimonials

PAGE_7:
IAPWE Professional Development Series 7  Biography Page Copy  Include things like:  Ø Your qualifications or experience relevant to the topic Ø Personal details about yourself  Ø Your background and how you came to write the book Ø What you hope your book will give your reader Ø Where you hope to go from here
